translation: Ta. Sin. Mim
These are verses of the Book that makes (things) clear

arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: It may be thou frettest thy soul with grief, that they do not become Believers

arabic: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةٗ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
translation: If (such) were Our Will, We could send down to them from the sky a Sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility

arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ
translation: But there comes not to them a newly-revealed Message from (Allah) Most Gracious, but they turn away therefrom

arabic: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: They have indeed rejected (the Message): so they will know soon (enough) the truth of what they mocked at

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ
translation: Do they not look at the earth,- how many noble things of all kinds We have produced therein

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Verily, in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily, thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful

arabic: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation: Behold, thy Lord called Moses: "Go to the people of iniquity
The people of the Pharaoh: will they not fear Allah

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
translation: He said: "O my Lord! I do fear that they will charge me with falsehood

arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
translation: My breast will be straitened. And my speech may not go (smoothly): so send unto Aaron

arabic: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ
translation: And (further), they have a charge of crime against me; and I fear they may slay me

arabic: قَالَ كـَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ
translation: Allah said: "By no means! proceed then, both of you, with Our Signs; We are with you, and will listen (to your call)

arabic: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: So go forth, both of you, to Pharaoh, and say: 'We have been sent by the Lord and Cherisher of the worlds
Send thou with us the Children of Israel

arabic: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدٗا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
translation: (Pharaoh) said: "Did we not cherish thee as a child among us, and didst thou not stay in our midst many years of thy life

arabic: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And thou didst a deed of thine which (thou knowest) thou didst, and thou art an ungrateful (wretch)

arabic: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذٗا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation: Moses said: "I did it then, when I was in error

arabic: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمٗا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
translation: So I fled from you (all) when I feared you; but my Lord has (since) invested me with judgment (and wisdom) and appointed me as one of the messengers

arabic: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٞ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation: And this is the favour with which thou dost reproach me,- that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel
Pharaoh said: "And what is the 'Lord and Cherisher of the worlds

arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation: (Moses) said: "The Lord and Cherisher of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- if ye want to be quite sure
(Pharaoh) said to those around: "Did ye not listen (to what he says)
(Moses) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers from the beginning

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
translation: (Pharaoh) said: "Truly your messenger who has been sent to you is a veritable madman

arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: (Moses) said: "Lord of the East and the West, and all between! if ye only had sense

arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ
translation: (Pharaoh) said: "If thou dost put forward any god other than me, I will certainly put thee in prison
(Moses) said: "Even if I showed you something clear (and) convincing

arabic: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation: (Pharaoh) said: "Show it then, if thou tellest the truth

arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: So (Moses) threw his rod, and behold, it was a serpent, plain (for all to see)

arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
translation: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders

arabic: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٞ
translation: (Pharaoh) said to the Chiefs around him: "This is indeed a sorcerer well-versed

arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ
translation: His plan is to get you out of your land by his sorcery; then what is it ye counsel

arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
translation: They said: "Keep him and his brother in suspense (for a while), and dispatch to the Cities heralds to collect
And bring up to thee all (our) sorcerers well-versed
So the sorcerers were got together for the appointment of a day well-known
And the people were told: "Are ye (now) assembled

arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
translation: That we may follow the sorcerers (in religion) if they win

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
translation: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Pharaoh: "Of course - shall we have a (suitable) reward if we win

arabic: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation: He said: "Yea, (and more),- for ye shall in that case be (raised to posts) nearest (to my person)

arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ
translation: Moses said to them: "Throw ye - that which ye are about to throw

arabic: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
translation: So they threw their ropes and their rods, and said: "By the might of Pharaoh, it is we who will certainly win

arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ
translation: Then Moses threw his rod, when, behold, it straightway swallows up all the falsehoods which they fake
Then did the sorcerers fall down, prostrate in adoration
Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the Worlds
The Lord of Moses and Aaron

arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: Said (Pharaoh): "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? surely he is your leader, who has taught you sorcery! but soon shall ye know! Be sure I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will cause you all to die on the cross

arabic: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation: They said: "No matter! for us, we shall but return to our Lord

arabic: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Only, our desire is that our Lord will forgive us our faults, that we may become foremost among the believers

arabic: ۞ وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation: By inspiration we told Moses: "Travel by night with my servants; for surely ye shall be pursued
Then Pharaoh sent heralds to (all) the Cities
(Saying): "These (Israelites) are but a small band
And they are raging furiously against us
But we are a multitude amply fore-warned
So We expelled them from gardens, springs
Treasures, and every kind of honourable position
Thus it was, but We made the Children of Israel inheritors of such things
So they pursued them at sunrise

arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ
translation: And when the two bodies saw each other, the people of Moses said: "We are sure to be overtaken

arabic: قَالَ كـَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
translation: (Moses) said: "By no means! my Lord is with me! Soon will He guide me

arabic: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٖ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
translation: Then We told Moses by inspiration: "Strike the sea with thy rod." So it divided, and each separate part became like the huge, firm mass of a mountain
And We made the other party approach thither
We delivered Moses and all who were with him
But We drowned the others

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
And rehearse to them (something of) Abraham's story

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
translation: Behold, he said to his father and his people: "What worship ye

arabic: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامٗا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
translation: They said: "We worship idols, and we remain constantly in attendance on them
He said: "Do they listen to you when ye call (on them)
Or do you good or harm

arabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
translation: They said: "Nay, but we found our fathers doing thus (what we do)
He said: "Do ye then see whom ye have been worshipping
Ye and your fathers before you

arabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوّٞ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: For they are enemies to me; not so the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds
Who created me, and it is He Who guides me
Who gives me food and drink
And when I am ill, it is He Who cures me
Who will cause me to die, and then to life (again)

arabic: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: And who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the day of Judgment

arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation: O my Lord! bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous

arabic: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقٖ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
translation: Grant me honourable mention on the tongue of truth among the latest (generations)
Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss

arabic: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation: Forgive my father, for that he is among those astray
And let me not be in disgrace on the Day when (men) will be raised up

arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٞ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation: The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail

arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٖ
translation: But only he (will prosper) that brings to Allah a sound heart
To the righteous, the Garden will be brought near
And to those straying in Evil, the Fire will be placed in full view

arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
translation: And it shall be said to them: 'Where are the (gods) ye worshipped

arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation: Besides Allah? Can they help you or help themselves
Then they will be thrown headlong into the (Fire),- they and those straying in Evil
And the whole hosts of Iblis together
They will say there in their mutual bickerings

arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
translation: By Allah, we were truly in an error manifest
When we held you as equals with the Lord of the Worlds
And our seducers were only those who were steeped in guilt
Now, then, we have none to intercede (for us)
Nor a single friend to feel (for us)

arabic: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةٗ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Now if we only had a chance of return we shall truly be of those who believe

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Verily in this is a Sign but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
The people of Noah rejected the messengers

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: Behold, their brother Noah said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)
I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust
So fear Allah, and obey me

arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds
So fear Allah, and obey me
They said: "Shall we believe in thee when it is the meanest that follow thee

arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: He said: "And what do I know as to what they do

arabic: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّيۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: Their account is only with my Lord, if ye could (but) understand
I am not one to drive away those who believe
I am sent only to warn plainly in public

arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ
translation: They said: "If thou desist not, O Noah! thou shalt be stoned (to death)
He said: "O my Lord! truly my people have rejected me

arabic: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Judge Thou, then, between me and them openly, and deliver me and those of the Believers who are with me

arabic: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
translation: So We delivered him and those with him, in the Ark filled (with all creatures)
Thereafter We drowned those who remained behind

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
The 'Ad (people) rejected the messengers

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: Behold, their brother Hud said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)
I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust
So fear Allah and obey me

arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds
Do ye build a landmark on every high place to amuse yourselves
And do ye get for yourselves fine buildings in the hope of living therein (for ever)
And when ye exert your strong hand, do ye do it like men of absolute power
Now fear Allah, and obey me
Yea, fear Him Who has bestowed on you freely all that ye know
Freely has He bestowed on you cattle and sons
And Gardens and Springs

arabic: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
translation: Truly I fear for you the Penalty of a Great Day

arabic: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ
translation: They said: "It is the same to us whether thou admonish us or be not among (our) admonishers
This is no other than a customary device of the ancients
And we are not the ones to receive Pains and Penalties

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: So they rejected him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
The Thamud (people) rejected the messengers

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: Behold, their brother Salih said to them: "Will you not fear (Allah)
I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust
So fear Allah, and obey me

arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds
Will ye be left secure, in (the enjoyment of) all that ye have here
Gardens and Springs
And corn-fields and date-palms with spathes near breaking (with the weight of fruit)
And ye carve houses out of (rocky) mountains with great skill
But fear Allah and obey me
And follow not the bidding of those who are extravagant

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ
translation: Who make mischief in the land, and mend not (their ways)
They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched

arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا فَأۡتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation: Thou art no more than a mortal like us: then bring us a Sign, if thou tellest the truth

arabic: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٞ لَّهَا شِرۡبٞ وَلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
translation: He said: "Here is a she-camel: she has a right of watering, and ye have a right of watering, (severally) on a day appointed

arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
translation: Touch her not with harm, lest the Penalty of a Great Day seize you
But they ham-strung her: then did they become full of regrets

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: But the Penalty seized them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
The people of Lut rejected the messengers

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: Behold, their brother Lut said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)
I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust
So fear Allah and obey me

arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the lord of the Worlds
Of all the creatures in the world, will ye approach males

arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ
translation: And leave those whom Allah has created for you to be your mates? Nay, ye are a people transgressing (all limits)

arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡرَجِينَ
translation: They said: "If thou desist not, O Lut! thou wilt assuredly be cast out
He said: "I do detest your doings
O my Lord! deliver me and my family from such things as they do
So We delivered him and his family,- all
Except an old woman who lingered behind
But the rest We destroyed utterly

arabic: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرٗاۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
translation: We rained down on them a shower (of brimstone): and evil was the shower on those who were admonished (but heeded not)

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might Most Merciful
The Companions of the Wood rejected the messengers

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: Behold, Shu'aib said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)
I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust
So fear Allah and obey me

arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds

arabic: ۞ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡسِرِينَ
translation: Give just measure, and cause no loss (to others by fraud)
And weigh with scales true and upright

arabic: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
translation: And withhold not things justly due to men, nor do evil in the land, working mischief
And fear Him Who created you and (who created) the generations before (you)
They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched

arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
translation: Thou art no more than a mortal like us, and indeed we think thou art a liar

arabic: فَأَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation: Now cause a piece of the sky to fall on us, if thou art truthful
He said: "My Lord knows best what ye do

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation: But they rejected him. Then the punishment of a day of overshadowing gloom seized them, and that was the Penalty of a Great Day

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Verily in that is a Sign: but most of them do not believe
And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful
Verily this is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds
With it came down the spirit of Faith and Truth
To thy heart and mind, that thou mayest admonish
In the perspicuous Arabic tongue
Without doubt it is (announced) in the mystic Books of former peoples

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation: Is it not a Sign to them that the Learned of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)
Had We revealed it to any of the non-Arabs

arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it
Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the sinners

arabic: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
translation: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous Penalty
But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not
Then they will say: "Shall we be respited
Do they then ask for Our Penalty to be hastened on
Seest thou? If We do let them enjoy (this life) for a few years
Yet there comes to them at length the (Punishment) which they were promised

arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation: It will profit them not that they enjoyed (this life)

arabic: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation: Never did We destroy a population, but had its warners
By way of reminder; and We never are unjust
No evil ones have brought down this (Revelation)
It would neither suit them nor would they be able (to produce it)
Indeed they have been removed far from even (a chance of) hearing it

arabic: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation: So call not on any other god with Allah, or thou wilt be among those under the Penalty
And admonish thy nearest kinsmen

arabic: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And lower thy wing to the Believers who follow thee

arabic: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do
And put thy trust on the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
Who seeth thee standing forth (in prayer)
And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves
For it is He Who heareth and knoweth all things

arabic: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
translation: Shall I inform you, (O people!), on whom it is that the evil ones descend
They descend on every lying, wicked person
(Into whose ears) they pour hearsay vanities, and most of them are liars
And the Poets,- It is those straying in Evil, who follow them

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادٖ يَهِيمُونَ
translation: Seest thou not that they wander distracted in every valley
And that they say what they practise not

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٖ يَنقَلِبُونَ
translation: Except those who believe, work righteousness, engage much in the remembrance of Allah, and defend themselves only after they are unjustly attacked. And soon will the unjust assailants know what vicissitudes their affairs will take
